description:
She is the only human the alien fleet wants. Her father is the only one standing in their way.

In THE WOLF FATHER 3 | Sci-Fi Full Movie 4K, Lena and her father — a former pilot turned into a wolf by a secret Arctic lab — have barely survived the alien ship buried under the ice. Grom, the giant polar bear, is still with them. Spark, a tiny creature made of light, still clings to her father's shoulder. But the sky above the glacier is now full of ships.

Eyeless glass hounds pursue them across the ice. A fallen commander returns as something far worse. And when they reach the last town on the fjord, a giant face appears in the sky with an offer: bring Lena to the ice by noon, and the town lives.

The town has to choose.

Then the aliens turn her own father against her.

On the frozen fjord, wolves, a bear and a band of outcast monsters face the fleet in a final battle — while Lena has only one sound that might bring her father back.

This full sci-fi action movie combines an alien invasion, werewolves, a giant polar bear, a town's betrayal, and a father's love tested by the ultimate test.

Watch through the final scene. The mothership is not done with them yet.

Would you hand her over to save your town — or fight for her? Leave a comment and subscribe for more original AI sci-fi movies and THE WOLF FATHER saga.
